vsm2.12:118.1: So evaṃ katvā na kevalaṃ candimasūriye parāmasati.
vsm2.12:118.2: Sace icchati pādakathalikaṃ katvā pāde ṭhapeti, pīṭhaṃ katvā nisīdati, mañcaṃ katvā nipajjati, apassenaphalakaṃ katvā apassayati.
vsm2.12:118.4: Anekesupi hi bhikkhusatasahassesu evaṃ karontesu tesañca ekamekassa tatheva ijjhati.
vsm2.12:118.6: Yathā hi pātisahassesu udakapūresu sabbapātīsu ca candamaṇḍalāni dissanti.
vsm2.12:118.7: Pākatikameva ca candassa gamanaṃ ālokakaraṇañca hoti.
vsm2.12:119.2: Kāyena vasaṃ vattetīti tattha brahmaloke kāyena attano vasaṃ vatteti.
vsm2.12:119.6: Sace so iddhimā cetovasippatto brahmalokaṃ gantukāmo hoti, dūrepi santike adhiṭṭhāti santike hotūti, santike hoti.
vsm2.12:119.7: Santikepi dūre adhiṭṭhāti dūre hotūti, dūre hoti.
vsm2.12:119.8: Bahukampi thokanti adhiṭṭhāti thokaṃ hotūti, thokaṃ hoti.
vsm2.12:119.9: Thokampi bahukanti adhiṭṭhāti bahukaṃ hotūti, bahukaṃ hoti.
vsm2.12:119.10: Dibbena cakkhunā tassa brahmuno rūpaṃ passati.
vsm2.12:119.11: Dibbāya sotadhātuyā tassa brahmuno saddaṃ suṇāti.
vsm2.12:119.13: Sace so iddhimā cetovasippatto dissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṃ gantukāmo hoti, kāyavasena cittaṃ pariṇāmeti, kāyavasena cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti,
vsm2.12:119.14: kāyavasena cittaṃ pariṇāmetvā kāyavasena cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahitvā sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamitvā dissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṃ gacchati.
vsm2.12:119.15: Sace so iddhimā cetovasippatto adissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṃ gantukāmo hoti, cittavasena kāyaṃ pariṇāmeti, cittavasena kāyaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
vsm2.12:119.16: Cittavasena kāyaṃ pariṇāmetvā cittavasena kāyaṃ adhiṭṭhahitvā sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamitvā adissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṃ gacchati.
vsm2.12:119.17: So tassa brahmuno purato rūpaṃ abhinimmināti manomayaṃ sabbaṅgapañcaṅgiṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
vsm2.12:119.18: Sace so iddhimā caṅkamati, nimmitopi tattha caṅkamati.
vsm2.12:119.19: Sace so iddhimā tiṭṭhati, nisīdati, seyyaṃ kappeti, nimmitopi tattha seyyaṃ kappeti.
vsm2.12:119.20: Sace so iddhimā dhūmāyati, pajjalati, dhammaṃ bhāsati, pañhaṃ pucchati, pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti, nimmitopi tattha pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti.
vsm2.12:119.21: Sace so iddhimā tena brahmunā saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati, sallapati, sākacchaṃ samāpajjati, nimmitopi tattha tena brahmunā saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati, sallapati, sākacchaṃ samāpajjati.
vsm2.12:119.22: Yaṃ yadeva hi so iddhimā karoti, taṃ tadeva nimmito karotī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 3.12).
vsm2.12:120.2: pādakajjhānato vuṭṭhāya dūre devalokaṃ vā brahmalokaṃ vā āvajjati santike hotūti.
vsm2.12:120.3: Āvajjitvā parikammaṃ katvā puna samāpajjitvā ñāṇena adhiṭṭhāti santike hotūti, santike hoti.
vsm2.12:121.1: Tattha ko dūraṃ gahetvā santikaṃ akāsīti?
vsm2.12:121.3: Bhagavā hi yamakapāṭihāriyāvasāne devalokaṃ gacchanto yugandharañca sineruñca santike katvā
vsm2.12:121.4: pathavītalato ekapādaṃ yugandhare patiṭṭhapetvā dutiyaṃ sinerumatthake ṭhapesi.
vsm2.12:122.3: Thero hi sāvatthito bhattakiccaṃ katvā nikkhantaṃ dvādasayojanikaṃ parisaṃ tiṃsayojanaṃ saṅkassanagaramaggaṃ saṅkhipitvā taṅkhaṇaññeva sampāpesi.
vsm2.12:123.2: Dubbhikkhasamaye kira therassa santikaṃ pātova satta bhikkhusatāni āgamaṃsu.
vsm2.12:123.3: Thero ‘‘mahā bhikkhusaṅgho kuhiṃ bhikkhācāro bhavissatī’’ti cintento sakalatambapaṇṇidīpe adisvā
vsm2.12:123.5: bhikkhū pattacīvaraṃ gāhāpetvā ‘‘ethāvuso, bhikkhācāraṃ gamissāmā’’ti pathaviṃ saṅkhipitvā pāṭaliputtaṃ gato.
vsm2.12:123.9: Āvuso, mahallakattherā nāma dūrepi gahetvā santike karontīti.
vsm2.12:123.11: Nanu, āvuso, antarā ekaṃ nīlamātikaṃ atikkamitvā āgatatthāti?
vsm2.12:123.13: Āvuso, mahallakattherā nāma mahantampi khuddakaṃ karontīti.
vsm2.12:124.1: Yathā cāyaṃ, evaṃ tissadattattheropi sāyanhasamaye nhāyitvā katuttarāsaṅgo mahābodhiṃ vandissāmīti citte uppanne santike akāsi.
vsm2.12:125.3: Bhagavā hi attano ca aṅgulimālassa (ma. ni. 2.348) ca antaraṃ santikampi dūramakāsīti.
vsm2.12:126.3: Rājagahe kira nakkhattadivase pañcasatā kumāriyo candapūve gahetvā nakkhattakīḷanatthāya gacchantiyo bhagavantaṃ disvā kiñci nādaṃsu.
vsm2.12:126.4: Pacchato āgacchantaṃ pana theraṃ disvā amhākaṃ thero eti pūvaṃ dassāmāti sabbā pūve gahetvā theraṃ upasaṅkamiṃsu.
vsm2.12:127.3: Mahākassapatthero kira sattāhaṃ samāpattiyā vītināmetvā daliddasaṅgahaṃ karonto kākavaliyassa nāma duggatamanussassa gharadvāre aṭṭhāsi.
vsm2.12:127.4: Tassa jāyā theraṃ disvā patino pakkaṃ aloṇambilayāguṃ patte ākiri.
vsm2.12:127.5: Thero taṃ gahetvā bhagavato hatthe ṭhapesi.
vsm2.12:128.1: Na kevalañca thokassa bahukaraṇaṃ, madhuraṃ amadhuraṃ, amadhuraṃ madhurantiādīsupi yaṃ yaṃ icchati, sabbaṃ iddhimato ijjhati.
vsm2.12:128.2: Tathā hi mahāanuḷatthero nāma sambahule bhikkhū piṇḍāya caritvā sukkhabhattameva labhitvā gaṅgātīre nisīditvā paribhuñjamāne disvā
vsm2.12:128.3: gaṅgāya udakaṃ sappimaṇḍanti adhiṭṭhahitvā sāmaṇerānaṃ saññaṃ adāsi.
vsm2.12:129.1: Dibbenacakkhunāti idheva ṭhito ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā tassa brahmuno rūpaṃ passati.
vsm2.12:129.2: Idheva ca ṭhito sabbaṃ tassa bhāsato saddaṃ suṇāti. Cittaṃ pajānāti.
vsm2.12:130.1: Kāyavasena cittaṃ pariṇāmetīti karajakāyassa vasena cittaṃ pariṇāmeti.
vsm2.12:131.1: Sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamatīti pādakajjhānārammaṇena iddhicittena sahajātaṃ sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamati pavisati phasseti sampāpuṇāti.
vsm2.12:131.2: Sukhasaññā nāma upekkhāsampayuttasaññā. Upekkhā hi santaṃ sukhanti vuttā.
vsm2.12:131.3: Sāyeva ca saññā nīvaraṇehi ceva vitakkādīhi paccanīkehi ca vimuttattā lahusaññātipi veditabbā.
vsm2.12:131.4: Taṃ okkantassa panassa karajakāyopi tūlapicu viya sallahuko hoti.
vsm2.12:131.5: So evaṃ vāyukkhittatūlapicunā viya sallahukena dissamānena kāyena brahmalokaṃ gacchati.
vsm2.12:132.1: Evaṃ gacchanto ca sace icchati pathavīkasiṇavasena ākāse maggaṃ nimminitvā padasā gacchati.
vsm2.12:132.2: Sace icchati vāyokasiṇavasena vāyuṃ adhiṭṭhahitvā tūlapicu viya vāyunā gacchati.
vsm2.12:132.4: ‘‘Sati hi gantukāmatāya’’ evaṃ katacittādhiṭṭhāno adhiṭṭhānavegukkhittova so issāsakhittasaro viya dissamāno gacchati.
vsm2.12:133.1: Cittavasena kāyaṃ pariṇāmetīti kāyaṃ gahetvā citte āropeti.
vsm2.12:133.2: Cittānugatikaṃ karoti sīghagamanaṃ. Cittagamanaṃ hi sīghaṃ hoti.
vsm2.12:133.3: Sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamatīti rūpakāyārammaṇena iddhicittena sahajātaṃ sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamatīti.
vsm2.12:134.1: Evaṃ adissamānena kāyena gacchanto panāyaṃ kiṃ tassa adhiṭṭhānacittassa uppādakkhaṇe gacchati, udāhu ṭhitikkhaṇe bhaṅgakkhaṇe vāti vutte tīsupi khaṇesu gacchatīti thero āha.
vsm2.12:134.2: Kiṃ pana so sayaṃ gacchati nimmitaṃ pesetīti.
vsm2.12:134.3: Yathāruci karoti. Idha panassa sayaṃ gamanameva āgataṃ.
vsm2.12:135.4: Sace iddhimā caṅkamati nimmitopi tattha caṅkamatītiādi sabbaṃ sāvakanimmitaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ.
vsm2.12:135.5: Buddhanimmito pana yaṃ yaṃ bhagavā karoti, taṃ tampi karoti. Bhagavato rucivasena aññampi karotīti.
vsm2.12:136.1: Ettha ca yaṃ so iddhimā idheva ṭhito dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena cittaṃ pajānāti, na ettāvatā kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
vsm2.12:136.2: Yampi so idheva ṭhito tena brahmunā saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati sallapati sākacchaṃ samāpajjati, ettāvatāpi na kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
vsm2.12:136.3: Yampissa dūrepi santike adhiṭṭhātītiādikaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ, ettāvatāpi na kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
vsm2.12:136.4: Yampi so dissamānena vā adissamānena vā kāyena brahmalokaṃ gacchati, ettāvatāpi na kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
vsm2.12:136.5: Yañca kho so tassa brahmuno purato rūpaṃ abhinimminātītiādinā nayena vuttavidhānaṃ āpajjati, ettāvatā kāyena vasaṃ vatteti nāmaṃ.
vsm2.12:136.6: Sesaṃ panettha kāyena vasaṃ vattanāya pubbabhāgadassanatthaṃ vuttanti ayaṃ tāva adhiṭṭhānā iddhi.
vsm2.12:137.1: Vikubbanāya pana manomayāya ca idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ.
vsm2.12:137.2: Vikubbanaṃ tāva karontena ‘‘so pakativaṇṇaṃ vijahitvā kumārakavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, nāgavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, supaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, asuravaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, indavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, devavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, brahmavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti,
vsm2.12:137.3: samuddavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, pabbatavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, sīhavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, byagghavaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, dīpivaṇṇaṃ vā dasseti, hatthimpi dasseti, assampi dasseti, rathampi dasseti, pattimpi dasseti, vividhampi senābyūhaṃ dassetī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 3.13) evaṃ vuttesu kumārakavaṇṇādīsu yaṃ yaṃ ākaṅkhati, taṃ taṃ adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:138.1: Adhiṭṭhahantena ca pathavīkasiṇādīsu aññatarārammaṇato abhiññāpādakajjhānato vuṭṭhāya attano kumārakavaṇṇo āvajjitabbo.
vsm2.12:138.2: Āvajjitvā parikammāvasāne puna samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya evarūpo nāma kumārako homīti adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:138.3: Saha adhiṭṭhānacittena kumārako hoti devadatto viya (cūḷava. 333).
vsm2.12:138.5: Hatthimpi dassetītiādi panettha bahiddhāpi hatthiādidassanavasena vuttaṃ.
vsm2.12:138.6: Tattha hatthī homīti anadhiṭṭhahitvā hatthī hotūti adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ, assādīsupi eseva nayoti.
vsm2.12:139.1: Manomayaṃ kātukāmo pana pādakajjhānato vuṭṭhāya kāyaṃ tāva āvajjitvā vuttanayeneva susiro hotūti adhiṭṭhāti, susiro hoti.
vsm2.12:139.2: Athassa abbhantare aññaṃ kāyaṃ āvajjitvā parikammaṃ katvā vuttanayeneva adhiṭṭhāti, tassa abbhantare añño kāyo hotūti.
vsm2.12:139.3: So taṃ muñjamhā īsikaṃ viya kosiyā asiṃ viya karaṇḍāya ahiṃ viya ca abbāhati.
vsm2.12:139.4: Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘idha bhikkhu imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimmināti rūpiṃ manomayaṃ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
vsm2.12:139.5: Seyyathāpi puriso muñjamhā īsikaṃ pavāheyya, tassa evamassa ayaṃ muñjo ayaṃ īsikā, añño muñjo aññā īsikā, muñjamhātveva īsikā pavāḷhā’’tiādi (paṭi. ma. 3.14).
vsm2.12:139.6: Ettha ca yathā īsikādayo muñjādīhi sadisā honti, evaṃ manomayarūpaṃ iddhimatāsadisameva hotīti dassanatthaṃ etā upamā vuttāti.
vsm2.12:139.8: Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge Iddhividhaniddeso nāma Dvādasamo paricchedo.
